verdict: A daring structural clash between upper-management button-down attire and extreme lower-body casual relaxedness.
detailedQuote: Mr. Bari Ahmed delivers a masterclass in hybrid academic practicality with this ensemble. The crisp, ironed white button-up tucked tightly into dark trousers demands instant respect, while the choice of open-toed flip-flops proves that foot comfort reigns supreme over campus dress codes.
